messages.content: I'd like to start the air purifying function in my living room, please set the air conditioner to 'AIR_CLEAN' mode with strongest wind strength, with monitoring.

function.name: ThinQ_Connect
function.description: Send a command to control an LG ThinQ appliance, such as an air conditioner, by setting various operation modes and target settings. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

body.description: A dictionary containing the settings and modes to control the LG ThinQ appliance.

airConJobMode.description: The current job mode of the air conditioner.

windStrength.description: The strength of the air flow.

monitoringEnabled.description: Flag to enable or disable air quality monitoring.

airCleanOperationMode.description: The operation mode for air cleaning.

powerSaveEnabled.description: Flag to enable or disable power-saving mode.

coolTargetTemperature.description: The target temperature for cooling in degrees Celsius. Valid values range from 18 to 30.

targetTemperature.description: The general target temperature in degrees Celsius. Valid values range from 18 to 30.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to start the air purifying function in their living room. They want to set the air conditioner to 'AIR_CLEAN' mode with strongest wind strength, with monitoring.

We need to call the function ThinQ_Connect with the appropriate body. The user wants:

- airConJobMode: "AIR_CLEAN"
- windStrength: "HIGH" (strongest)
- monitoringEnabled: true

We don't need to set other fields unless we want to override defaults. The defaults are:

- airConJobMode default: COOL
- windStrength default: MID
- monitoringEnabled default: false
- airCleanOperationMode default: POWER_OFF
- powerSaveEnabled default: false
- coolTargetTemperature default: 24
- targetTemperature default: 22

We want to set airConJobMode to "AIR_CLEAN". We also want to set windStrength to "HIGH". We want monitoringEnabled to true. We might also want to set airCleanOperationMode to "POWER_ON" because we want to start the air purifying function. The user didn't explicitly mention turning on the air cleaning operation mode, but they said "start the air purifying function". That implies we should set airCleanOperationMode to "POWER_ON". The user didn't mention powerSaveEnabled, so we can leave it at default false. They didn't mention coolTargetTemperature or targetTemperature, so we can leave them at defaults.

Thus the function call should include:

{
  airConJobMode: "AIR_CLEAN",
  windStrength: "HIGH",
  monitoringEnabled: true,
  airCleanOperationMode: "POWER_ON"
}

We can optionally include powerSaveEnabled: false, but it's default. We can also include coolTargetTemperature: 24, targetTemperature: 22, but it's default. So we can just include the four fields.

We need to produce a JSON object with the function name and arguments. The format is:

{
  "name": "ThinQ_Connect",
  "arguments": {
    "body": {
      ...
    }
  }
}

We need to ensure we use correct JSON formatting. The user didn't ask for anything else. So we will call the function.
